integrity: All asserted ideals follow from explicit integer Hasse-jet minors. The self-review is not an independent audit; no external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The assertion concerns the second Hasse-jet determinantal scheme of one six-monomial toric surface, not a classification of arbitrary Togliatti systems or higher jets. The characteristic-zero rank profile was established in earlier work. Earlier general toric Fitting-ideal theory might implicitly yield aspects of the integral formula; equivalent unlocated computations remain possible.
title: The characteristic-two boundary jump in the second-osculating scheme of the Togliatti del Pezzo projection
